high_level_description: This image captures a mesmerizing underwater scene featuring a school of jellyfish swimming gracefully in a deep blue aquatic environment. The jellyfish are illuminated with a soft, ethereal glow, primarily in shades of purple and pink, which contrasts beautifully against the dark blue background. Each jellyfish has a translucent, bell-shaped body with delicate, flowing tentacles that trail behind them as they move through the water. The setting appears to be an aquarium or a similar controlled environment, given the uniformity and clarity of the water.
